title: AIR Plugins Index
description: Index of agent plugins available in this AIR configuration. A plugin is a named grouping of AIR primitives (skills, MCP servers, hooks) — a compositional unit for bundling and distributing related capabilities. Plugins do not define new artifacts inline; they reference existing artifacts by ID from the corresponding index files.

propertyNames.description: Plugin identifier key. Must be alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores.

Plugin.description: A plugin — a named grouping of AIR primitives (skills, MCP servers, hooks) for bundling and distribution. All referenced artifacts must be defined in their respective index files.

title.description: Human-readable display name for the plugin.

description.description: Concise description of what this plugin provides.

path.description: Path to the plugin directory containing a .plugin/plugin.json manifest. Either a relative path within the same catalog, or a remote URI handled by an installed catalog provider (e.g. github://owner/repo[@ref]/path). When set, the manifest supplies the plugin's bundled artifact references (skills, mcp_servers, hooks, plugins) and distribution metadata (author, version, homepage, repository, license, logo, keywords, title). Any of those fields declared inline on this entry take precedence over the manifest, letting the index stay a lightweight registry of name + description + path (+ default_in_roots).

skills.description: IDs of skills bundled by this plugin. Must reference skill IDs defined in skills.json indexes. May be declared here inline, or externalized into the .plugin/plugin.json manifest referenced by path.

mcp_servers.description: IDs of MCP servers bundled by this plugin. Must reference server IDs defined in mcp.json indexes.

hooks.description: IDs of hooks bundled by this plugin. Must reference hook IDs defined in hooks.json indexes.

plugins.description: IDs of other plugins to compose into this plugin. Referenced plugins' primitives (skills, mcp_servers, hooks) are recursively expanded and merged with this plugin's direct declarations. Circular references are rejected at resolution time.

homepage.description: URL to the plugin's homepage or documentation.

repository.description: URL or identifier for the plugin's source repository.

logo.description: Path or URL to the plugin's logo image.

default_in_roots.description: Names of roots this plugin is activated in by default. Use the literal "*" to activate it in every resolved root. This replaces the legacy default_plugins array that lived on root entries — membership is now declared on the artifact.
